## Weekly management summary
**Input** (POST JSON): week, projects[] {name, company, documents[] (file names), entries[] (outputs of the site-report workflow)}.

**Output**: totals, document checklist per project (contract signed? building office approval?), attention list, highlights, one-page Markdown summary.
